resources.string: Start a new anonymous conversation with Gradey support. This chat is separate from your Gradey ID. Previous anonymous conversations are not restored.
Intercom receives technical app and device information, plus messages and attachments you choose to send. Gradey does not automatically share your name, email, grades, or school account with chat.
Chat is unavailable in demo mode. You can browse the Help Center.
Confirm that you meet the app’s age requirement before starting a support chat. You can still browse the Help Center.
